item.title: Wang Gui-rong (王桂榮)
item.description: Wang Gui-rong (王桂榮) Wang Gui-rong (1931–2012), also known in English as Kenjohn Wang, was a Taiwanese American entrepreneur, philanthropist, and community leader.

item.title: Taiwanese American Foundation (TAF)
item.description: Taiwanese American Foundation (TAF) Taiwanese American Foundation (TAF) is a philanthropic foundation established in 1982 by Wang Gui-rong (王桂榮) to honor outstanding individuals who “care about Taiwan and identify Taiwan as their homeland.” It is sometimes called “The Nobel of Taiwan” (台灣的諾貝爾).

item.title: Sam Chang (張善良)
item.description: Sam Chang (張善良) Sam Chang (張善良, born 1960) is a Taiwanese American real estate developer known as the “旅館開發大王” (Hotel Development King) in New York’s Taiwanese American community.

item.title: Shawna Yang Ryan (楊小娜)
item.description: Shawna Yang Ryan (楊小娜) Shawna Yang Ryan (楊小娜) is a Taiwanese American novelist whose debut novel Green Island (《綠島》) won the 2017 American Book Awards.

item.description: Tiffany Huang (黃咏婷) Tiffany Frances Huang (黃咏婷) is a Taiwanese American filmmaker and director.

item.title: Wang Neng-xiang (王能祥)
item.description: Wang Neng-xiang (王能祥) Wang Neng-xiang (王能祥, 1933–) is a Taiwanese American CPA, Taiwan democracy lobbyist, and community leader based in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Charles Yang (楊嘉猷)
item.description: Charles Yang (楊嘉猷) Charles Yang (楊嘉猷) is the founding president (創會會長) of the Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS / 台美人歷史協會).
